'''Halloway''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], Halloway worked with the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] resistance to rescue Councilor [[Haronn]] after the transport smuggling him off-planet was shot down over the [[Blastfield Shipyards]].<ref name="Hostage Negotiations" />
